card.name: Inside mg dose expressions
card.fires_on: Pieces of dose expressions just before an expected unit like mg or kg, such as the hyphen-to in 'mg-to-mg basis' or a digit within a number. It fires in dosing tables and tablet-substitution warnings.

modes.label: mg-to-mg basis
modes.description: The linking '-to' or '-m' inside the phrase 'mg-to-mg basis' when comparing formulations.

modes.label: Digits in dose numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a dose number, right before mg/kg is expected.

card.writes: It suppresses the unit tokens mg and kg, so the next token is not predicted to be a unit yet.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a dose figure or the phrase 'mg-to-mg', where a unit like mg is not yet due.
